comments:
Two signatures: phyi la 360 and phyi ra 46.
The manuscript does not correspond to any item with the signature "ra 46" in [8H6M69W4]. It appears rather to correspond to No. 18824 (title: rgyal sras thogs med pa'i bka' 'bum thor bu), which however reports 153 folios.

name: thogs med bzang po dpal gyi bka' 'bum 'thor bu'i skor
